les-circuits-nord-de-madagascar-11jours-.title: The North of Madagascar
les-circuits-nord-de-madagascar-11jours-.summary: Eleven days across the whole north: the red tsingy, Diego Bay, vanilla plantations and the Nosy Be archipelago. Our most complete itinerary.

circuit-nature-traditions-du-nord-8-jour.title: Nature & Traditions of the North
circuit-nature-traditions-du-nord-8-jour.summary: Eight days between nature reserves and Sakalava villages. Meetings with local craftspeople, local markets and homestay nights.

circuit-sava.title: SAVA Tour
circuit-sava.summary: The vanilla route and Marojejy park. A region still untouched by mass tourism, between the Indian Ocean and rainforest.

tours-des-archipels-de-nosy-be.title: Nosy Be Archipelago Tour
tours-des-archipels-de-nosy-be.summary: Four days sailing between Nosy Iranja, Nosy Komba and Nosy Sakatia. Snorkeling, sandbanks and sunsets aboard a traditional boat.

une-experience-authentique.title: An Authentic Experience
une-experience-authentique.summary: Three days at village pace: dawn fishing, Sakalava cooking and a musical evening. Off the beaten tourist track.

randonnees-immersive-a-nosy-komba.title: Immersive Hike on Nosy Komba
randonnees-immersive-a-nosy-komba.summary: Two days of hiking on Lemur Island, from Ampangorina village to the summit. Homestay night and meeting with local embroiderers.

circuit-2-jours-a-lokobe.title: 2 Days at Lokobe
circuit-2-jours-a-lokobe.summary: The island's last stretch of primary forest, reached by traditional dugout canoe. Two days spotting black lemurs, boas and chameleons with a village guide.

meta.title: Nosy Be day trips & half-day excursions | Sakalava Tours
meta.description: Nosy Iranja, Tanikely, Lokobe, Mont Passot: our day and half-day excursions departing from Nosy Be, guided by our local team.

excursions.pageIntro: Half-day and full-day trips from your hotel: islets, sandbanks, primary forests and fishing villages. Transfer, guide and lunch included.

nosy-iranja.title: Nosy Iranja
nosy-iranja.summary: Two islets joined by a white sandbank that emerges at low tide. Fishing village, walk up to the lighthouse and snorkelling in turquoise water.

nosy-tanikely.title: Nosy Tanikely
nosy-tanikely.summary: The region's finest snorkelling spot: coral, tropical fish and turtles just metres from shore, inside a protected marine reserve.

nosy-komba-nosy-tanikely.title: Nosy Komba & Nosy Tanikely
nosy-komba-nosy-tanikely.summary: Lemur island in the morning, marine reserve in the afternoon. Meet the macaco lemurs, browse local crafts and snorkel, all in one day.

reserve-de-lokobe.title: Lokobe Reserve
reserve-de-lokobe.summary: Cross by traditional outrigger canoe, then walk with a guide through the island's last primary forest. Nocturnal lemurs, chameleons and Madagascar boas.

nosy-sakatia.title: Nosy Sakatia
nosy-sakatia.summary: The orchid island, 25 minutes by boat. Swim with green turtles in the seagrass beds, empty beaches and lunch facing the ocean.

mont-passot-coucher-de-soleil.title: Mont Passot at sunset
mont-passot-coucher-de-soleil.summary: The island's highest point and its sacred crater lakes. A 360° panorama over the archipelago as the sun drops into the Mozambique Channel.

mangroves-ambatozavavy.title: Ambatozavavy mangroves
mangroves-ambatozavavy.summary: Paddle the mangrove channels by outrigger canoe. Birdlife, fiddler crabs and a look at daily life in a Sakalava fishing village.

distillerie-ylang-ylang.title: Ylang-ylang distillery
distillerie-ylang-ylang.summary: Nosy Be's fragrant gold, from flower to essential oil. Visit a traditional distillery, walk the plantations and stop at the Sacred Tree.

about.pageIntro: Authentic experiences, attentive service and unforgettable memories in the heart of Madagascar.

values.title: Three principles behind every trip
values.subtitle: They aren't here to decorate a page: they decide which itineraries we build, which partners we work with, and which ones we turn down.

authenticite.title: Authenticity
authenticite.text: We favour places where local life carries on beyond the visitors. A Sakalava fishing village, a family ylang-ylang distillery, a path only islanders use — rather than a site laid out for tour buses.

respect.title: Respect
respect.text: Respect for the communities that host us, whose permission we always ask before bringing a group. Respect for the environment: no contact with turtles or lemurs, no anchoring on coral, nothing left behind on the islets.

partage.title: Sharing
partage.text: A good trip is measured by the encounters it made possible. Our guides translate, introduce and explain — and a share of every excursion goes directly to the families and communities who welcome you.

founder.title: A commitment born of passion
founder.p1: Since 2019 I have been building Sakalava Tours around one idea: sharing my vision of authentic travel in Madagascar. Close to the ground and to local realities, I design every route as a human adventure — respectful, sincere and meaningful.
founder.p2: It started with improvised outings: I took passing travellers to places I had known since childhood and that appeared in no programme. What struck my first clients wasn't the scenery — it was being able to sit down with a fishing family and understand what was being said around them.
founder.p3: Out of those outings came a conviction: Nosy Be and northern Madagascar deserve better than the identical day trip sold everywhere. So I built every tour and excursion myself, scouting the routes on site, meeting the host families, testing tide times and sailing durations before offering them to anyone.
founder.p4: Sakalava Tours remains a small operation today, and that is a choice. We would rather look after a limited number of travellers properly than fill boats.
founder.quote: Discover the treasures of Madagascar differently
founder.quoteAfter: Offering a genuine journey, rich in encounters and emotion.

mission.title: Unforgettable journeys across Madagascar
mission.text: Madagascar opens its doors to a deep, sincere and unforgettable immersion, paced by its smiles, its landscapes and its legends. From the Nosy Be archipelago to the vanilla plantations of the SAVA, through the primary forests of Lokobe and the tsingy of the far north, every itinerary is designed so you come home with more than photographs.

assistance.title: Support at any hour
assistance.text: So your stay is a genuine break, we stay reachable day and night to guide, advise and assist you at any moment — a delayed flight, weather that turns, a last-minute question.

equipe.title: A team that listens
equipe.text: We build a trip that fits you. Pace, budget, interests, health or age constraints: every itinerary is discussed before it is fixed, and nothing is locked once you are on site.

local.title: Real knowledge of the ground
local.text: Our first-hand knowledge of the region takes you to authentic places and meaningful encounters, away from the standard tourist circuits. Our guides come from the region and speak the local Malagasy.

groupes.title: Genuinely small groups
groupes.text: From 2 to 12 people depending on the trip, never more. It's what allows a village to actually welcome you, everyone to ask their questions, and the site itself not to suffer from your visit.

guides.question: Are your guides from the region?
guides.answer: Yes. Our guides were born and live in Nosy Be or northern Madagascar. That's what lets us enter a fishing village as expected guests rather than tolerated visitors, and translate not just the words but the context.

langues.question: Which languages are the excursions run in?
langues.answer: We guide in French, English, German and Italian. Tell us your language when booking: we always confirm a guide is available before validating your trip.

reservation.question: How far ahead should I book?
reservation.answer: For a day excursion, 48 hours is usually enough, sometimes less outside high season. For a multi-day tour, allow two to four weeks: we need to book accommodation and coordinate guides across several stages.

groupes-taille.question: How many people per group?
groupes-taille.answer: From 2 to 12 depending on the trip, and 2 to 8 for canoe or forest excursions. We never group beyond that, even when demand would allow it.

meilleure-periode.question: When is the best time to visit Nosy Be?
meilleure-periode.answer: April to November, the dry season, offers the best sailing conditions and underwater visibility. December to March, the rainy season, remains workable for land excursions, with spectacular vegetation and far fewer people.

paiement.question: How does payment work?
paiement.answer: A deposit confirms the booking, the balance is settled on site before departure. We accept cash in ariary and euros, as well as online payment for the deposit.

cta.reassurance: Reply within 24 hours · Free quote, no commitment
